about_the_game:
Classroom Reverie is a Metroidvania game focused on combat and exploration. Control a simple stick figure and explore a fantasy world drawn from your class notes. Your goal is simple: survive in this universe born of boredom and improve your grades!

Battle Questions

In this world, problems... literally come alive. Face the sharp equations of Math, the attacking spelling rules of Literature, and the scribbled figures that leap from the pages of History. In this notebook, every question is an enemy to be overcome.

Raise Your Grade, Survive

Your health bar represents your success rate in the class. Every blow you take lowers your grade, while every victory you win makes you a more successful student. How far will you go on this journey from D+ to A+?

A World Comes to Life in a Notebook

Each lesson is a unique biome, created with different art styles. These artistic worlds are filled with enemies whose questions come to life, waiting to be solved. Defeat them and continue on your way, answering the questions one by one.

Face the Finals

At the end of each biome, a test meticulously prepared by the course instructor awaits you: a Boss! Pass these challenging tests to earn access to the next lesson's page.

The Secret Behind the Pages

Uncover the truth about why this world was created by piecing together notes and memories hidden in the notebook's margins.

Features:

- A classic Metroidvania experience focused on exploration and combat.

- A unique and creative concept, straight out of a student's notebook.

- Visually unique biomes, each representing a different lesson.

- Lesson levels with unique platforming mechanics and enemies.

- An innovative enemy mechanic where you answer questions as you kill.

- Challenging and thematic boss battles await you at the end of each lesson.

short_description: Embark on an adventure in the notebook of a student bored during class! Raise your grade by fighting and exploring in this 2D Metroidvania where drawings come to life and questions turn into enemies.
